_comment: Corpus for the Davison reading (Services/DavisonInterpreter.cs). The Davison chart is one real chart for two people, cast for the moment and place halfway between their births, and read as the chart of the relationship itself. Every line here is therefore about the relationship or about the two people together, never about one person. Nothing is generated at run time: the interpreter only chooses lines and joins them.

notes.intro: The Davison chart is cast for the moment halfway between the two births, at the place halfway between the two birthplaces. Synastry sets one chart against the other; this is a single real chart, with a real sky, and astrologers read it as the chart of the relationship itself: what it is for, how it feels from inside, and where its effort goes.
notes.untimed: A birth time is missing, so the midpoint may be hours out. The Ascendant, Midheaven, houses and Moon are left out, and what follows reads the slower-moving parts of the chart only.
notes.reflection: Read this as a description of the relationship's habits and not as a forecast of how it will go. Two people can live the same chart well or badly.
notes.noAspects: None of the relationship's main planets is in close aspect to another. Each works on its own account, and no one theme runs the whole chart.
notes.contactsIntro: A planet in one person's own chart that stands on a main point of the Davison chart ties that person closely to that side of the relationship.
notes.noContacts: Neither person has a planet standing on a main point of the Davison chart. The relationship has its own character, close to neither one of them in particular.
notes.pointer: The Davison chart has a reading, a wheel and a worksheet of its own: choose Davison chart at the top of the Synastry view.

_character_comment: The relationship's Sun, Moon and Ascendant by sign. Keys are sign names.

sun.Aries: The relationship is at its best when it is starting something. It has energy and directness to spare, and little patience for standing still; what it needs is a shared venture to pour itself into, and room for each person to act without asking first.
sun.Taurus: This is a relationship built for the long run. It finds its purpose in making something solid and comfortable together: a home, a routine, a way of living well. It is slow to change course, which is its strength and, when change is needed, its difficulty.
sun.Gemini: Talk is the heart of it. The relationship lives on conversation, curiosity and shared jokes, and stays fresh as long as there is something new to tell each other. It is light on its feet and can struggle when asked to stay with one heavy subject for long.
sun.Cancer: The relationship's purpose is care. It turns naturally towards home, family and looking after one another, and it remembers everything. It is strongest as a refuge, and has to take care that the refuge does not become a place to hide from the world.
sun.Leo: The relationship wants to be enjoyed and to be seen. It has warmth, pride and a taste for doing things in style, and it brings out the performer in both people. It thrives on appreciation given freely and wilts when either person feels taken for granted.
sun.Virgo: This relationship proves itself in practical things. It is at its best when it is useful: fixing, improving, working side by side on something that needs doing. Its care shows in detail and service, and it has to watch that helpful criticism does not become the only language it speaks.
sun.Libra: Partnership itself is the point. The relationship puts fairness, courtesy and balance first, and both people are more considerate inside it than outside. It dislikes open conflict, sometimes too much, and does well to say the awkward thing before it grows.
sun.Scorpio: The relationship goes deep or not at all. It is intense, private and loyal, and it changes both people. It is strongest when it can face hard things together, and it has to guard against possessiveness and against keeping score in silence.
sun.Sagittarius: The relationship is an adventure. It finds its purpose in travel, learning, big plans and honest talk about what matters, and it gives both people room. It needs a horizon to move towards, and gets restless when life narrows to routine.
sun.Capricorn: This is a relationship with a job to do. It is serious, dependable and ambitious, and it measures itself by what it builds and what it can be relied on for. It takes time to warm up and tends to grow stronger with every year it lasts.
sun.Aquarius: Friendship is the foundation. The relationship values independence, ideas and the freedom to be unlike other couples, and it gives each person unusual room to be themselves. It can keep feelings at arm's length and benefits from saying the warm thing out loud.
sun.Pisces: The relationship runs on feeling and imagination more than on plans. It is gentle, forgiving and attuned, with a sense that the two belong together that needs no explaining. Its edges are soft, and it has to make an effort to be clear about practical things.

moon.Aries: Feelings in this relationship are quick and openly shown. Tempers flare and clear just as fast, and neither person is left guessing for long. It feels most at home when things are moving.
moon.Taurus: The emotional climate is steady and comforting. The relationship is soothed by good food, familiar places and physical closeness, and it does not like its routines disturbed. Security here is something that can be touched.
moon.Gemini: The relationship settles itself by talking. Feelings are put into words, turned over and often laughed about, and silence is what unsettles it. It needs variety to feel at ease.
moon.Cancer: The relationship is emotionally close and protective. Each looks after the other almost by instinct, moods are quickly caught, and home matters a great deal. Hurts go deep here and need to be spoken of and not nursed.
moon.Leo: The relationship feels good when it is generous and playful. Affection is shown warmly and a little theatrically, and each person needs to feel special to the other. Being ignored is what wounds it.
moon.Virgo: Care is shown through doing: the small practical kindness, the thing noticed and put right. The relationship feels secure when life is in order, and frets when it is not. It can worry more than it needs to.
moon.Libra: The relationship is at ease when things are fair and pleasant between the two. It smooths rough moments quickly and prefers agreement, and it can leave real feelings unsaid for the sake of peace.
moon.Scorpio: Feelings here run strong and are not shown lightly. The bond is intense and trusting once trust is given, and it is slow to forget an injury. Emotional honesty, however uncomfortable, is what keeps it healthy.
moon.Sagittarius: The mood of the relationship is buoyant and frank. It feels most itself when it is out in the world, laughing, travelling or arguing about ideas. Neither person is allowed to brood for long.
moon.Capricorn: Feelings are held in reserve and shown through reliability more than through words. The relationship feels safe when responsibilities are met, and it may need reminding that tenderness is not a weakness.
moon.Aquarius: The emotional tone is friendly and even. The relationship gives each person space and does not crowd, and it feels most comfortable when feelings can be talked about coolly. Warmth has to be chosen on purpose.
moon.Pisces: The two are highly sensitive to each other's moods, often without a word said. The relationship is tender and forgiving, and it soaks up the atmosphere around it. It needs quiet time to recover itself.

rising.Aries: Seen from outside, this is an energetic pair that acts first and explains later. The relationship meets the world head-on and others tend to notice it arriving.
rising.Taurus: To other people the two look settled and unhurried, a pair that knows what it likes. The relationship presents a calm, steady face and does not rush for anyone.
rising.Gemini: Others see a lively, talkative pair, quick with a story and interested in everything. The relationship meets the world with curiosity and a ready word.
rising.Cancer: The relationship shows a protective, homely face. Others see two people who look after each other and who make guests feel looked after too, though it does not open up to everyone.
rising.Leo: This is a pair that people notice. The relationship carries itself with warmth and a certain flourish, and tends to become the centre of a room without trying very hard.
rising.Virgo: Others see a capable, modest pair that gets things done. The relationship presents itself quietly and is more interested in being useful than in being admired.
rising.Libra: The two come across as a natural couple: gracious, well matched and easy to be around. The relationship puts its most agreeable side forward, and is good at making others comfortable.
rising.Scorpio: The relationship keeps itself to itself. Others sense a strong bond and a closed door, and the pair gives little away until it has decided someone can be trusted.
rising.Sagittarius: Others see a cheerful, outgoing pair, always on the way somewhere. The relationship meets the world with enthusiasm and plain speaking.
rising.Capricorn: The relationship looks serious and well established, even when it is new. Others see a dependable pair with plans, and tend to treat it with respect.
rising.Aquarius: The two strike others as an unusual pair that goes its own way. The relationship meets the world in a friendly, slightly detached manner and does not much mind what convention expects.
rising.Pisces: The relationship shows a gentle, hard-to-define face. Others find the pair kind and a little dreamy, and may not be sure where one person ends and the other begins.

_houses_comment: A Davison planet in a house: where in life that side of the relationship is lived. Keys are "Planet|House". Sun, Moon, Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter and Saturn each have all twelve.

houses.Sun|1: The relationship has a strong identity of its own. It is plainly visible to others and is a large part of how each person now presents themselves.
houses.Sun|2: The relationship centres on what the two build and own together. Earning, spending and a shared sense of worth are where its energy goes.
houses.Sun|3: Everyday contact is the life of it: talk, messages, errands, the neighbourhood, brothers and sisters. It is a relationship of constant small exchanges.
houses.Sun|4: Home is the centre. The relationship is most itself in private, and making a household or a family together is close to its purpose.
houses.Sun|5: The relationship exists to be enjoyed. Romance, play, creative projects and, for many, children are where it shines.
houses.Sun|6: This is a working relationship in the best sense. Its life is in daily routine, shared tasks and looking after each other's health and wellbeing.
houses.Sun|7: The relationship is centred on partnership itself. The two think of themselves as a pair, and commitment comes naturally to it.
houses.Sun|8: The relationship's core is intimacy and trust. Shared money, shared secrets and going through deep changes together are what it is about.
houses.Sun|9: The relationship looks outward and upward. Travel, study and a shared view of what life means are central, and it broadens both people.
houses.Sun|10: The relationship has a public role. It is bound up with career, reputation or a shared ambition, and others know the two as a pair.
houses.Sun|11: The two are friends first. The relationship thrives among other people, in groups and causes, and is carried by shared hopes for the future.
houses.Sun|12: Much of the relationship is lived out of sight. It has a private, even secret, inner life, and gives both people a place to retreat to.
houses.Moon|1: Feelings are on the surface. What the two feel shows at once, to each other and to everyone else, and the relationship is led by its moods.
houses.Moon|2: Emotional security is tied to material security. The two feel safe when there is enough put by, and comfort each other with tangible things.
houses.Moon|3: The relationship is settled by talk. Daily conversation, however ordinary, is what keeps the two feeling close.
houses.Moon|4: The emotional bond is rooted in home and family. The two feel most deeply connected in their own space, and the relationship has a strong sense of belonging.
houses.Moon|5: The two feel closest when they are playing. Fun, affection and shared pleasures feed the bond, and it has a youthful emotional tone.
houses.Moon|6: Care is shown in daily routine. The two look after each other in practical ways, and the relationship is upset when ordinary life is out of order.
houses.Moon|7: Each needs the other emotionally, and knows it. The relationship is tender and responsive, and each person's mood depends a good deal on the other's.
houses.Moon|8: The emotional bond is intense and private. The two share feelings that go unspoken elsewhere, and crises tend to bring them closer.
houses.Moon|9: The two feel at home when exploring. Shared beliefs, journeys and learning nourish the bond, and the relationship is emotionally restless when confined.
houses.Moon|10: The relationship's feelings are bound up with its standing in the world. The two care how they are seen, and public life can stir private emotion.
houses.Moon|11: The emotional tone is one of friendship. The two feel secure among friends and shared ideals, and are comfortable giving each other room.
houses.Moon|12: A great deal is felt and little is said. The two are sensitive to each other at a level below words, and need time alone together to stay close.
houses.Mercury|1: The two are known for their talk. Ideas are exchanged freely and quickly, and the relationship thinks out loud.
houses.Mercury|2: Conversation turns to practical matters: money, plans, what things are worth. The two think well together about resources.
houses.Mercury|3: Communication is constant and easy. The two are always in touch, share news at once, and understand each other's shorthand.
houses.Mercury|4: The real conversations happen at home. The two talk most openly in private, and family matters are much discussed.
houses.Mercury|5: Talk is playful. The two enjoy wit, games and stories, and flirt with words.
houses.Mercury|6: The two are good at working things out together. Discussion is practical and detailed, and they plan the day between them.
houses.Mercury|7: Everything is talked through. The two negotiate well, seek each other's opinion, and treat conversation as the way to stay equal.
houses.Mercury|8: The two can talk about what is usually left unsaid. Conversation goes to motives, money and fears, and they keep each other's confidences.
houses.Mercury|9: The two talk about ideas. Beliefs, travel and study are favourite subjects, and each stretches the other's thinking.
houses.Mercury|10: The two think and plan with an eye to the world. They discuss work and aims, and may be known together for what they say or write.
houses.Mercury|11: Conversation ranges widely and includes other people. The two share ideas with friends and talk a good deal about the future.
houses.Mercury|12: Some things are understood between the two without being said. Private thoughts are shared quietly, and each needs to check they have truly been heard.
houses.Venus|1: Affection is plain to see. The relationship has charm and warmth on the surface, and others find the two pleasant company.
houses.Venus|2: The two enjoy the good things of life together. Shared comforts, taste and money are sources of pleasure, and they are generous with each other.
houses.Venus|3: Affection is shown in words and small attentions. The two enjoy each other's conversation and the ordinary round of daily life.
houses.Venus|4: Love is expressed at home. The two take pleasure in making a place of their own beautiful and peaceful.
houses.Venus|5: This is a romantic placement. The relationship is affectionate, playful and fond of pleasure, and courtship does not stop.
houses.Venus|6: Love shows in everyday kindness. The two enjoy working together and take pleasure in looking after each other.
houses.Venus|7: Affection and partnership go together. The two are well disposed to each other, co-operate easily, and enjoy being a couple.
houses.Venus|8: The attraction is strong and private. Intimacy matters greatly, and the two share resources as readily as feelings.
houses.Venus|9: The two love to explore together. Travel, learning and foreign things are shared pleasures, and they admire each other's outlook.
houses.Venus|10: The relationship is well regarded. The two present an attractive front to the world, and affection is bound up with shared standing or work.
houses.Venus|11: Affection has the ease of friendship. The two like each other as well as love each other, and enjoy a shared social life.
houses.Venus|12: Love is felt deeply and shown privately. The relationship has a tender, hidden side, and may ask for sacrifice from one or both.
houses.Mars|1: The relationship is energetic and assertive. The two spur each other to act, and disagreements are open and soon over.
houses.Mars|2: Effort goes into earning and acquiring. The two work hard for what they have, and money is the likeliest thing to quarrel about.
houses.Mars|3: Talk is lively and sometimes sharp. The two debate, tease and argue, and say what they think.
houses.Mars|4: The energy of the relationship is spent at home. There is much doing and changing in the household, and domestic matters are where tempers are tested.
houses.Mars|5: Desire and play are strong. The two are passionate, competitive in fun, and keen to do exciting things together.
houses.Mars|6: The two work hard side by side. Effort goes into daily tasks, and irritation tends to arise over how things should be done.
houses.Mars|7: The two push each other. The relationship is stimulating and can be combative, and it needs a fair way to disagree.
houses.Mars|8: Desire is intense. The relationship has strong physical and emotional drive, and power between the two needs honest handling.
houses.Mars|9: The two are stirred to adventure. Energy goes into travel, causes and argument about beliefs, and they urge each other further.
houses.Mars|10: The relationship is ambitious. The two drive each other towards achievement, and effort is directed at shared goals in the world.
houses.Mars|11: Energy goes into friends, groups and plans for the future. The two act well as a team among others.
houses.Mars|12: Anger and desire are kept under the surface. The two may avoid open conflict, and do better when grievances are brought into the light.
houses.Jupiter|1: The relationship is generous and good-humoured. It makes both people more confident, and others are drawn to its optimism.
houses.Jupiter|2: The two prosper together, or expect to. There is generosity with money and a shared appetite for comfort that needs some restraint.
houses.Jupiter|3: Conversation is expansive and enjoyable. The two learn a great deal from each other in the ordinary course of things.
houses.Jupiter|4: Home is a place of plenty and welcome. The two are happiest in their own space, and family life tends to grow.
houses.Jupiter|5: There is much fun. The relationship is playful, lucky in its pleasures, and generous with affection.
houses.Jupiter|6: The two help each other in daily life. Work together goes well, and they improve each other's habits.
houses.Jupiter|7: The partnership itself is a source of growth. Each feels better off for the other, and they are generous in their dealings.
houses.Jupiter|8: The two benefit from what they share. Trust is rewarded, and the relationship gains from pooled resources and deep honesty.
houses.Jupiter|9: Shared beliefs and journeys are the relationship's great pleasure. The two widen each other's world.
houses.Jupiter|10: The relationship is good for both people's standing. Shared ambitions are large, and the two are seen as fortunate.
houses.Jupiter|11: The two are rich in friends and hopes. The relationship opens doors socially and looks forward with confidence.
houses.Jupiter|12: The relationship has a protected, private kind of good fortune. The two give each other faith in difficult times.
houses.Saturn|1: The relationship takes itself seriously. It can feel weighty or cautious at first, and it gains a steady dignity with time.
houses.Saturn|2: The two are careful with money. Security is worked for, not assumed, and shared resources are a matter of duty.
houses.Saturn|3: Communication takes effort. The two weigh their words, and plain honest talk has to be practised until it becomes a habit.
houses.Saturn|4: Home carries responsibility. The two may shoulder family duties, and build a household slowly and solidly.
houses.Saturn|5: Pleasure does not come lightly. The two can be shy of play or romance, and benefit from making deliberate room for enjoyment.
houses.Saturn|6: The two take daily duties seriously. They are reliable to each other in practical things, and can let work crowd out everything else.
houses.Saturn|7: Commitment is the central matter. The relationship is tested on whether each can be counted on, and it lasts where that test is met.
houses.Saturn|8: Trust is built slowly. The two are cautious about what they share, and intimacy deepens only as each proves dependable.
houses.Saturn|9: The two take beliefs seriously and may differ on them. The relationship matures through working out a shared outlook.
houses.Saturn|10: The relationship carries public responsibility. The two work hard for standing, and are judged, and judge themselves, by results.
houses.Saturn|11: Friendships are few and lasting. The two are serious about shared aims, and slow to let others in.
houses.Saturn|12: Old fears sit in the background. The two may carry unspoken burdens, and are helped by naming what each is afraid of.

houseAreas.1: the face it shows and the way it begins things
houseAreas.2: money, possessions and what the two value
houseAreas.3: talk, daily contact and near surroundings
houseAreas.12: solitude, rest and what is kept hidden

_aspects_comment: Aspects inside the Davison chart. Keys are "Point|Tone|Point" with the two points in standard order (Sun, Moon, Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn…) and Tone one of Conjunction, Flow (sextile, trine) or Tension (square, opposition). Besides the seven planets among themselves there are lines for the Sun, Moon, Venus and Mars with Uranus, Neptune and Pluto, and for a planet on the Ascendant or Midheaven. Any pair without a line here is written from pointThemes and toneLinks.

aspects.Sun|Conjunction|Moon: What the relationship is for and what it needs to feel safe are the same thing. It is unusually single-minded and self-contained, which gives it strength and can leave little room for anything outside itself.
aspects.Sun|Flow|Moon: The relationship's purpose and its feelings work together. What the two set out to do and what makes them comfortable agree, and that gives the whole chart an easy coherence.
aspects.Sun|Tension|Moon: What the relationship aims at and what it needs emotionally pull different ways. The two may find that getting on with life and feeling close compete for attention, and the tension keeps the relationship from growing complacent.
aspects.Sun|Conjunction|Mercury: The relationship knows its own mind and says it. Thinking and purpose are one, so the two talk readily about where they are going.
aspects.Sun|Conjunction|Venus: Affection lies close to the heart of the relationship. The two plainly like each other, and warmth colours everything they do together.
aspects.Sun|Conjunction|Mars: The relationship is driven. It has a great deal of energy and will, acts decisively, and can be quick to anger when thwarted.
aspects.Sun|Flow|Mars: The relationship has energy that goes where it is aimed. The two act well together, and desire and purpose support each other.
aspects.Sun|Tension|Mars: There is friction at the centre. The two provoke each other, and the relationship has to learn to use its force on shared aims and not on each other.
aspects.Sun|Conjunction|Jupiter: The relationship is expansive and optimistic at its core. It thinks big, enjoys life, and makes both people feel fortunate.
aspects.Sun|Flow|Jupiter: Good humour and good fortune come easily. The relationship encourages growth, and things tend to turn out well for it.
aspects.Sun|Tension|Jupiter: The relationship is inclined to overdo things. Enthusiasm is plentiful and judgment sometimes less so, and the two do well to check their promises against their means.
aspects.Sun|Conjunction|Saturn: Responsibility sits at the centre of the relationship. It is serious, loyal and enduring, and it can feel heavy until both people accept what it asks of them.
aspects.Sun|Flow|Saturn: The relationship is steady and realistic. It handles duty without resentment, and builds patiently on firm ground.
aspects.Sun|Tension|Saturn: The relationship meets obstacles and delays, and is tested by them. It can feel restrictive, and it earns a durability that easier bonds do not have.
aspects.Moon|Conjunction|Mercury: Feelings are readily put into words. The two talk about how they feel as a matter of course, and understand each other's moods.
aspects.Moon|Flow|Mercury: Thinking and feeling keep company. The two can discuss emotional matters calmly and are good at reassuring each other.
aspects.Moon|Tension|Mercury: What is felt and what is said do not always match. The two can talk past each other when upset, and need to listen for the feeling behind the words.
aspects.Moon|Conjunction|Venus: The relationship is tender and affectionate by nature. Comfort and love are one thing here, and the two are gentle with each other.
aspects.Moon|Flow|Venus: Affection flows without effort. The two enjoy each other's company and make each other feel cared for.
aspects.Moon|Tension|Venus: Needs and wants are a little out of step. One may look for closeness when the other looks for pleasure, and small adjustments keep either from feeling slighted.
aspects.Moon|Conjunction|Mars: Emotions run hot. The relationship is passionate and reactive, and feelings turn into action at once.
aspects.Moon|Flow|Mars: Feeling gives energy and energy gives warmth. The two act on their instincts together and are lively in each other's company.
aspects.Moon|Tension|Mars: Moods and tempers set each other off. The relationship can be quarrelsome over small things, and it is helped by not letting irritation pass for honesty.
aspects.Moon|Conjunction|Jupiter: The emotional tone is generous and warm-hearted. The two are kind to each other and feel free to be themselves.
aspects.Moon|Flow|Jupiter: There is an easy goodwill between the two. The relationship is emotionally open and makes each person feel supported.
aspects.Moon|Tension|Jupiter: Feelings are large and sometimes larger than the occasion. The two can indulge each other too much, or promise comfort they cannot always give.
aspects.Moon|Conjunction|Saturn: Feelings are taken seriously and shown with restraint. The bond is loyal and dutiful, and may need encouragement to be openly tender.
aspects.Moon|Flow|Saturn: The relationship is emotionally steady. The two can be relied on by each other, and feelings mature well with time.
aspects.Moon|Tension|Saturn: There is a sense of emotional distance to overcome. One or both may feel unsupported at times, and the relationship grows by answering that feeling with deeds.
aspects.Mercury|Conjunction|Venus: The two speak kindly to each other. Conversation is a pleasure, and affection is easily expressed in words.
aspects.Mercury|Flow|Venus: Talk between the two is agreeable and considerate. They share tastes and enjoy discussing them.
aspects.Mercury|Conjunction|Mars: Conversation is quick, direct and sometimes heated. The two say what they think and decide fast.
aspects.Mercury|Flow|Mars: The two think and act in step. Plans are made and carried out briskly, and debate is enjoyed.
aspects.Mercury|Tension|Mars: Words can become weapons. The two argue readily, and do well to slow down before answering.
aspects.Mercury|Conjunction|Jupiter: The two never run out of things to talk about. Ideas are large and conversation is generous and hopeful.
aspects.Mercury|Flow|Jupiter: Talk is broad-minded and encouraging. The two learn from each other and plan confidently.
aspects.Mercury|Tension|Jupiter: The two are apt to say more than they mean or promise more than they can deliver. Plans need checking against detail.
aspects.Mercury|Conjunction|Saturn: The two speak carefully and mean what they say. Conversation is serious and practical, and can be sparing.
aspects.Mercury|Flow|Saturn: The two think things through together. Their plans are sound, and their word to each other holds.
aspects.Mercury|Tension|Saturn: Communication is hesitant or critical. Things may go unsaid for fear of the answer, and patient, plain speaking has to be learned.
aspects.Venus|Conjunction|Mars: Affection and desire are joined. The attraction is strong and evident, and the relationship has a great deal of warmth and energy.
aspects.Venus|Flow|Mars: Affection and desire work together comfortably. The two are at ease with each other physically and enjoy doing things together.
aspects.Venus|Tension|Mars: Attraction is strong and restless. What one wants and what the other offers do not always arrive together, which keeps the relationship lively and at times contentious.
aspects.Venus|Conjunction|Jupiter: The relationship is warm, generous and fond of pleasure. The two enjoy life together and are lavish with affection.
aspects.Venus|Flow|Jupiter: There is ease, generosity and good feeling. The two bring out each other's kindness and tend to be lucky together.
aspects.Venus|Tension|Jupiter: The two are inclined to indulge. Pleasure and spending can run ahead of sense, and affection may be taken for granted.
aspects.Venus|Conjunction|Saturn: Affection is serious and lasting. The two are loyal and take their feelings for each other as a commitment, and may be reserved in showing them.
aspects.Venus|Flow|Saturn: Love is steady and dependable. The relationship values faithfulness, and affection deepens over the years.
aspects.Venus|Tension|Saturn: Affection meets restraint. One or both may feel unappreciated or hold back for fear of rejection, and warmth has to be offered deliberately.
aspects.Mars|Conjunction|Jupiter: The relationship has enormous drive and confidence. The two take on large undertakings and encourage each other's boldness.
aspects.Mars|Flow|Jupiter: Energy is well directed and well rewarded. The two act with confidence and enjoy shared ventures.
aspects.Mars|Tension|Jupiter: The two tend to overreach. Enthusiasm outruns stamina, and they do well to choose their battles and finish what they start.
aspects.Mars|Conjunction|Saturn: Energy is disciplined and held in. The two can work very hard together, and frustration builds when effort is blocked.
aspects.Mars|Flow|Saturn: Effort is steady and productive. The two have staying power and get difficult things done.
aspects.Mars|Tension|Saturn: Drive meets resistance. One pushes while the other brakes, and the relationship needs patience to keep frustration from hardening into resentment.
aspects.Jupiter|Conjunction|Saturn: Hope and caution are bound together. The relationship plans for the long term and builds steadily towards it.
aspects.Jupiter|Flow|Saturn: Optimism and realism are in balance. The two grow at a pace they can sustain.
aspects.Jupiter|Tension|Saturn: The relationship swings between expanding and holding back. The two may disagree on when to risk and when to save, and do best when each respects the other's instinct.
aspects.Sun|Conjunction|Uranus: The relationship is unconventional at its core. It began, or behaves, in a way neither person expected, and it needs freedom and surprise to stay alive.
aspects.Sun|Flow|Uranus: The relationship is refreshingly free. The two give each other room, enjoy doing things their own way, and keep each other interested.
aspects.Sun|Tension|Uranus: The relationship is restless and hard to settle. Sudden changes of course unsettle it, and it lasts best where neither person tries to fence the other in.
aspects.Sun|Conjunction|Neptune: The relationship is idealistic and a little other-worldly. The two see the best in each other, and need to check now and then that they are seeing each other clearly.
aspects.Sun|Flow|Neptune: Imagination and sympathy come easily. The two share dreams and are gentle with each other's weaknesses.
aspects.Sun|Tension|Neptune: The relationship is prone to illusion. Hopes can outrun facts and things may be left vague, so plain honesty is worth more here than in most.
aspects.Sun|Conjunction|Pluto: The relationship is intense and transforming. It takes hold of both people, changes them, and does nothing by halves.
aspects.Sun|Flow|Pluto: The relationship has depth and staying power. The two can face serious matters together and come out stronger.
aspects.Sun|Tension|Pluto: Questions of power run through the relationship. Each may try to control the other, and it does best when control is given up on both sides.
aspects.Moon|Conjunction|Uranus: The emotional life of the relationship is changeable and exciting. Feelings arrive suddenly, and the two need space as much as closeness.
aspects.Moon|Flow|Uranus: The two are emotionally at ease with each other's independence. The bond stays fresh and is not smothering.
aspects.Moon|Tension|Uranus: Closeness and freedom are at odds. Moods shift without warning, and one may pull away just as the other draws near.
aspects.Moon|Conjunction|Neptune: The two are deeply attuned and can seem to read each other's feelings. The bond is tender and dreamy, and easily bruised by harshness.
aspects.Moon|Flow|Neptune: There is a gentle, intuitive understanding between the two. They comfort each other without needing many words.
aspects.Moon|Tension|Neptune: Feelings are easily confused. The two may misread each other's moods or avoid saying what hurts, and clarity has to be worked at.
aspects.Moon|Conjunction|Pluto: The emotional bond is very deep and can be consuming. The two feel bound to each other in a way that is hard to explain.
aspects.Moon|Flow|Pluto: Feelings run deep and are trusted. The two can share what they would tell no one else.
aspects.Moon|Tension|Pluto: Strong feelings bring strong reactions. Jealousy or emotional pressure can arise, and the bond is healthiest when nothing is held over the other.
aspects.Venus|Conjunction|Uranus: Affection is exciting and unpredictable. The attraction was probably sudden, and the two need novelty to keep it bright.
aspects.Venus|Flow|Uranus: Affection is lively and unpossessive. The two enjoy surprising each other and do not cling.
aspects.Venus|Tension|Uranus: Affection blows hot and cold. The two may find closeness comes in bursts, and steadiness has to be chosen.
aspects.Venus|Conjunction|Neptune: Love is romantic and idealised. The two are devoted and tender, and may put each other on a pedestal.
aspects.Venus|Flow|Neptune: Affection is gentle, imaginative and kind. The two bring out each other's compassion.
aspects.Venus|Tension|Neptune: Love is clouded by wishful thinking. One may give too much or expect too much, and disappointment is avoided by seeing each other as they are.
aspects.Venus|Conjunction|Pluto: The attraction is powerful and absorbing. Love goes very deep here and can become possessive.
aspects.Venus|Flow|Pluto: Affection is deep and lasting. The two are strongly drawn to each other and loyal.
aspects.Venus|Tension|Pluto: Love and control become entangled. Intense attachment can turn to jealousy, and trust has to be given freely.
aspects.Mars|Conjunction|Uranus: The relationship is impulsive and electric. The two act on the spur of the moment and tempers can flash.
aspects.Mars|Flow|Uranus: The two are energised by each other's originality. They enjoy taking chances and trying new things together.
aspects.Mars|Tension|Uranus: The relationship is volatile. Sudden quarrels and sudden changes of direction are likely, and it needs an outlet for its restlessness.
aspects.Mars|Conjunction|Neptune: Energy is put at the service of an ideal. The two act on inspiration, and can lose their way when the goal is unclear.
aspects.Mars|Flow|Neptune: Drive and imagination work together. The two are good at acting on what they sense and at helping others.
aspects.Mars|Tension|Neptune: Effort tends to leak away. The two may avoid confrontation or act at cross purposes, and do better with clear, stated aims.
aspects.Mars|Conjunction|Pluto: The relationship has formidable drive. Together the two can move mountains, and their conflicts are correspondingly fierce.
aspects.Mars|Flow|Pluto: The two have great stamina and determination together. What they set out to do, they finish.
aspects.Mars|Tension|Pluto: Wills collide. Struggles for the upper hand can become intense, and the force is better spent on a common task.
aspects.Sun|Conjunction|Ascendant: The relationship is exactly what it appears to be. Its purpose is written on its face, and it makes a strong, clear impression.
aspects.Moon|Conjunction|Ascendant: The relationship wears its heart on its sleeve. Its moods are visible to everyone, and it comes across as warm and responsive.
aspects.Mercury|Conjunction|Ascendant: The relationship presents itself through talk. The two are seen as lively, communicative and always in discussion.
aspects.Venus|Conjunction|Ascendant: The relationship is attractive to others. It presents itself with charm and evident affection.
aspects.Mars|Conjunction|Ascendant: The relationship comes across as forceful and energetic. It acts decisively and can seem combative.
aspects.Jupiter|Conjunction|Ascendant: The relationship has an open, generous manner. Others find it encouraging and good-humoured.
aspects.Saturn|Conjunction|Ascendant: The relationship has a serious, reserved manner. It is slow to show itself and commands respect.
aspects.Sun|Conjunction|Midheaven: The relationship has a clear aim in the world. It is visible, purposeful and likely to be known for something.
aspects.Moon|Conjunction|Midheaven: The relationship's private feelings are bound up with its public life. The two care deeply about what they are working towards together.
aspects.Mercury|Conjunction|Midheaven: The relationship is known for its ideas or its words. Shared plans are much discussed and clearly stated.
aspects.Venus|Conjunction|Midheaven: The relationship is well liked and well regarded. Its affection is public, and it may be bound up with art or with pleasing others.
aspects.Mars|Conjunction|Midheaven: The relationship is ambitious and hard-working. Its energy is aimed at achievement in the world.
aspects.Jupiter|Conjunction|Midheaven: The relationship is fortunate in its public life. Shared aims are large and tend to prosper.
aspects.Saturn|Conjunction|Midheaven: The relationship carries heavy responsibility in the world. It is taken seriously and achieves through long effort.

_blocks_comment: Building blocks for an aspect with no line of its own: the sentence in toneLinks for its tone, with {first} and {second} filled from pointThemes.

toneLinks.Conjunction: The relationship's {first} and its {second} are bound together and act as one.
toneLinks.Flow: The relationship's {first} and its {second} support each other without effort.
toneLinks.Tension: The relationship's {first} and its {second} pull against each other, and it takes some work to give both their due.

_contacts_comment: One person's own planet standing on a main point of the Davison chart. Keys are the Davison point; {name} is the person and {theme} what their planet stands for (from personThemes).

contacts.Sun: {name}'s {theme} stands on the relationship's Sun. What the relationship is for lies close to what {name} is about, and {name} tends to carry its sense of purpose.
contacts.Moon: {name}'s {theme} stands on the relationship's Moon. {name} feels the relationship's moods most directly and has a large hand in its emotional climate.
contacts.Venus: {name}'s {theme} stands on the relationship's Venus. {name} is closely tied to the affection in the relationship and to what the two enjoy together.
contacts.Mars: {name}'s {theme} stands on the relationship's Mars. {name} tends to supply the push, and is also the one most stirred when the relationship is at odds.
contacts.Saturn: {name}'s {theme} stands on the relationship's Saturn. {name} feels its duties and limits most keenly, and is often the one who holds it to its commitments.
contacts.Ascendant: {name}'s {theme} stands on the relationship's Ascendant. Others tend to see the relationship through {name}, who sets much of its outward manner.
contacts.Midheaven: {name}'s {theme} stands on the relationship's Midheaven. {name} is closely tied to the relationship's aims and its place in the world.
